summary: Add a Console tab on hosts using the same noVNC ticket/tunnel path as VMs (empty vm_id asks Core for a local host RFB shell), and CD/DVD insert/eject from the VM console via durable vm-media. API impact: changed contract (openHostConsole, host consoleStream, optional ConsoleRequest.vm_id) and new contract (mediaVM, vm-media command, vm-media-v1).

guide.reason: Hosts gain a Console tab; VM console toolbar gains CD/DVD insert and eject with guest device notes.

api.reason: Host console reuses console-v1 with openHostConsole and empty-vm_id console requests; mediaVM adds vm-media / vm-media-v1 for insert and eject (new/changed contracts).

state.reason: Current VM media_id is journaled on the pool-master managed VM record and re-adopted with the VM; host console sessions are in-memory tickets only (same as VM consoles).
state.record: managed_resources vm-create command/spec.media_id updated by vm-media success; inventory/adoption recovers it with the VM

verification.method: go test ./internal/controller -run 'Console|HostConsole|Media'; go test ./internal/vmhost -run 'HostConsole|Media'; go test ./internal/agent -run Console; web tsc --noEmit; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree
verification.limits: Browser walkthrough of host console and CD/DVD insert/eject against a disposable lab host is not yet recorded.
